intro: Follow obscure clues, manipulate bizarre contraptions and explore deviously complex dollhouse as you uncover the mysteries within Waldegrave Manor…
description:
Fireproof Games are proud to bring the fourth instalment of the critically acclaimed game series ‘The Room’ to Nintendo Switch™.

The Room 4: Old Sins features a fantastical, multi-room dollhouse to explore and continues the engaging puzzle gameplay of its predecessors set against the background of a tragic story. Explore unsettling locations, follow obscure clues and manipulate bizarre contraptions as you uncover the mysteries within Waldegrave Manor…

Captivating Puzzles & Fantastical Setting: Explore a deviously complex dollhouse which transforms at your touch. Each room is a portal to a new, stunning environment complete with intricate objects to decipher, mind bending puzzles to solve and mysteries to uncover. 

Compelling Story:  The sudden disappearance of an ambitious engineer and his high-society wife which provokes the hunt for a precious artefact. The trail leads to the attic of their home, and the discovery of an old, peculiar dollhouse… 

Optimised for Nintendo Switch™: Explore The Room 4: Old Sins using either the touch screen or Joy-Con™ motion controls for a tactile experience so natural you can almost feel the turn of each key and the click of every lock. The combination of innovative mechanics and interactive controls create a memorizing experience from beginning to end.
